title: Stagewise rational compact-support target comparison
statement: The integral proper/open comparison and its normalized localization produce the family of rational stage isomorphisms; transition compatibility is intentionally left to the second split statement.

proof.text: For each finite coefficient field, the normalized completed-refinement theorem identifies the canonical open refinement natural transformation with an invertible component. The open adjunction and cancellation against refinement restriction prove this equality. Whisker the inverse transformation with proper direct image and its compositor to compare compactifications.

Replace the second compactification target map by its composite with the inverse target isomorphism. Compare it with the first compactification via the existing graph-image common refinement inf and its two projections. The completed direct-image target isomorphism and the raw isomorphism pullback comparison identify the resulting functor with compact support followed by constructible integral pullback. Use the qcqs realization and full-subcategory fullness to restrict the ambient comparison.

Localize the integral natural isomorphism. The prescribed rational compact-support maps and rational pullback maps have the same pure-tensor formulas, so the scalar-localization component-isomorphism theorem applies. Finally conjugate by the two ring systems rationalLeft identifications and choose this isomorphism at each common finite field stage.

proof_origin.place: Construct the stagewise family by completed compactification refinement, target transport, scalar localization, and the rationalLeft identifications.
